primary_sources.cite: Carroll et al., PLOS Genetics 2011, doi:10.1371/journal.pgen.1002117

structures.notes: 7PRX is wild-type human GR LBD, numbering equals UniProt. White paper residues are AncCR numbering: add 531. Ancestral series available as backup; 3GN8 numbering runs one lower than AncCR after about position 212.

known_limitations: The NR3C1 TOGA2 reference is the GR-gamma isoform: positions after 451 are one higher than UniProt/7PRX numbering. Applying this wrongly shifts the entire ligand-binding domain.
Experimental landscape is 16 genotypes (4 sites), while the AncGR1 to AncGR2 branch carries 39 substitutions. 2^39 is not enumerable; K must be scoped to the assayed sites.
The Carroll 2011 stability table is calculated, not measured.
No cortisol-bound ancestral structure exists; 2Q1V is titled cortisol but its deposited ligand is prednisone.
expected_outcome_note: This is the strongest case: real ancestral sequences, a real combinatorial panel, and full species coverage. If epistaeon cannot replicate here, it is unlikely to replicate anywhere.

replication_targets.finding: S106P and L111Q switch AncCR specificity toward cortisol; introduced alone into AncCR they yield a non-functional receptor.
replication_targets.source: Ortlund 2007; residue tokens S106P and L111Q appear 11 and 10 times
replication_targets.test: Does epistaeon rank the 106-111 pair as coupled, and does it place the permissive group before them in the ordering?

replication_targets.finding: Permissive substitutions (group X) include Y27R, L29M, F98I, Q105L, N26T, S212D; they are required before the switch is tolerated.
replication_targets.test: Recall of these positions among epistaeon's detected partners of 106/111.

replication_targets.finding: The functional shift is contingent: reversal is blocked by later substitutions (epistatic ratchet).
replication_targets.test: Does epistaeon's path likelihood show asymmetry between forward and reverse orderings?

white_paper_claims_not_in_source.finding: The white paper names Tyr27 and Thr36 as the permissive pair.
white_paper_claims_not_in_source.test: KNOWN ERROR. Position 36 is Ala in AncCR and Gly in both derived receptors; Thr never occurs. The literature pair is Y27R plus L29M. Do not score epistaeon against Thr36.

authority_rule: The original study is the sole authority for what counts as a replication target. Claims in white_paper_claims_not_in_source have no published source in the local materials; epistaeon must NOT be scored against them. Record what epistaeon says about them for information only, and never count a mismatch as an epistaeon failure.
